1	"""Core service surface for StreamMill.
2	
3	The frozen baseline only reports process health; that surface stays
4	unchanged. On top of it this module now implements named event-time
5	tumbling windows with explicit watermarks:
6	
7	* streams are created with a positive ``window_ms`` and a non-negative
8	  ``allowed_lateness_ms``;
9	* events carry an integer ``timestamp_ms`` and a finite numeric ``value``
10	  and land in the left-closed, right-open window
11	  ``[floor(timestamp_ms / window_ms) * window_ms, +window_ms)``;
12	* a per-stream watermark only moves forward; once it reaches
13	  ``window_end_ms + allowed_lateness_ms`` the window is final, is
14	  emitted exactly once, and is retained for queries;
15	* events with ``timestamp_ms < watermark - allowed_lateness_ms`` are
16	  acknowledged but dropped without touching the aggregates.
17	
18	Streams may optionally be created with a positive ``slide_ms`` (no
19	larger than ``window_ms`` and dividing it evenly). Such streams use
20	fixed-step overlapping sliding windows: an accepted event at timestamp
21	``t`` is counted once in every window ``[start, start + window_ms)``
22	whose ``start`` is an integer multiple of ``slide_ms`` and satisfies
23	``start <= t < start + window_ms`` (negative timestamps follow the same
24	mathematical grid). Every window still finalizes independently once the
25	watermark reaches its own ``window_end_ms + allowed_lateness_ms`` and is
26	emitted exactly once, ordered by window start. Without ``slide_ms`` the
27	stream is the plain tumbling stream above and every public shape is
28	unchanged.
29	
30	Streams may optionally enable event-id deduplication by passing a
31	positive ``dedup_retention_ms`` (no smaller than ``allowed_lateness_ms``)
32	at creation time. On such streams every event must carry a non-empty
33	string ``event_id``:
34	
35	* the first occurrence of an id is aggregated and remembered together
36	  with its ``timestamp_ms`` and ``value``;
37	* an exact retry (same ``timestamp_ms`` and numerically equal ``value``)
38	  is reported as ``duplicate: true`` and never touches the aggregates —
39	  the dedup check runs before the lateness check, so retained retries
40	  are duplicates even past the lateness horizon;
41	* the same id with a different timestamp or value is rejected with
42	  ``event_id_conflict`` and leaves all state untouched;
43	* an unseen id that arrives too late is dropped as usual and its id is
44	  not remembered.
45	
46	Remembered ids are evicted once the watermark advances past
47	``timestamp_ms + dedup_retention_ms`` (ids exactly on the boundary are
48	kept); evicted ids may be reused and are treated as new events.
49	
50	Streams created with a non-negative ``auto_watermark_lag_ms`` track the
51	maximum ``timestamp_ms`` of every successfully accepted event. After an
52	event is aggregated (and its id registered, when deduplicating) the
53	watermark advances atomically to
54	``max(current_watermark, max_event_timestamp - auto_watermark_lag_ms)``;
55	the lateness/dedup decision for that event uses the watermark as it was
56	before the advance. Dropped, duplicate or conflicting events never move
57	the maximum event timestamp or the watermark. Manual watermark posts keep
58	working on automatic streams and subsequent automatic advances never
59	regress below a manual watermark. Event responses on automatic streams
60	additionally carry the post-processing ``watermark_ms`` (``null`` until a
61	watermark exists) and the windows finalized by that response.
62	
63	A portable full-state snapshot is available through
64	``Service.snapshot`` / ``Service.restore_snapshot``: export produces a
65	self-contained JSON document (``format_version`` 1) capturing config,
66	watermark, open windows, finalized results and retained dedup records;
67	automatic streams additionally carry ``auto_watermark_lag_ms`` and
68	``max_event_timestamp_ms``; sliding streams additionally carry
69	``slide_ms`` (a document without it restores as a tumbling stream).
70	Restore is only accepted on an instance
71	without any streams, validates the document strictly (never silently
72	repairing it) and publishes the whole state atomically.
73	
74	In-process dimension tables provide the lookup side of an optional
75	current-value stream-table join:
76	
77	* ``POST /tables`` creates a named table; rows are written with
78	  ``PUT``-style upserts of non-empty string ``key``/``label`` pairs and
79	  report whether the stored label actually ``changed``;
80	* a stream may be created with ``lookup_table`` naming an existing
81	  table. Events on such a stream must carry a non-empty ``lookup_key``;
82	  after the usual dedup and lateness decisions the current label is read
83	  atomically (an unknown key is rejected with ``lookup_key_not_found``
84	  and leaves all state untouched) and the event is aggregated both into
85	  the plain windows and into per-window ``(lookup_key, label)`` groups.
86	  Later table writes only affect later events. Dedup records on joined
87	  streams include the ``lookup_key``, so resubmitting an id with a
88	  different key is an ``event_id_conflict``;
89	* joined groups finalize together with their window and are exposed
90	  through ``Service.joined_results``, ordered by window start, lookup
91	  key and label.
92	
93	Snapshots export as ``format_version`` 2 (adding ``tables`` plus
94	``lookup_table``/``joined_windows``/``joined_finalized`` on joined
95	streams) whenever any table exists, and restore stays compatible with
96	version 1 documents. When the join is unused every public shape and the
97	version 1 snapshot are unchanged.
98	
99	Disk persistence remains out of scope.
100	"""
101	
102	from __future__ import annotations
103	
104	import math
105	import threading
106	
107	from . import __version__
108	
109	SNAPSHOT_FORMAT_VERSION = 1
110	SNAPSHOT_FORMAT_VERSION_JOIN = 2
111	
112	
113	class StreamExistsError(Exception):
114	    """Raised when creating a stream that already exists."""
115	
116	
117	class StreamNotFoundError(Exception):
118	    """Raised when addressing a stream that does not exist."""
119	
120	
121	class TableExistsError(Exception):
122	    """Raised when creating a table that already exists."""
123	
124	
125	class TableNotFoundError(Exception):
126	    """Raised when addressing a table that does not exist."""
127	
128	
129	class LookupKeyNotFoundError(Exception):
130	    """Raised when an event's lookup_key has no row in the table."""
131	
132	
133	class JoinNotEnabledError(Exception):
134	    """Raised when querying joined results on a plain stream."""
135	
136	
137	class WatermarkRegressionError(Exception):
138	    """Raised when a new watermark would move the stream backwards."""
139

165	class _Stream:
166	    """Mutable state of one named stream. Guarded by the Service lock."""
167	
168	    def __init__(
169	        self,
170	        name: str,
171	        window_ms: int,
172	        allowed_lateness_ms: int,
173	        dedup_retention_ms: int | None = None,
174	        auto_watermark_lag_ms: int | None = None,
175	        slide_ms: int | None = None,
176	        lookup_table: str | None = None,
177	    ) -> None:
178	        self.name = name
179	        self.window_ms = window_ms
180	        self.allowed_lateness_ms = allowed_lateness_ms
181	        self.dedup_retention_ms = dedup_retention_ms
182	        self.auto_watermark_lag_ms = auto_watermark_lag_ms
183	        # None selects the tumbling grid (step == window_ms); otherwise the
184	        # stream is sliding with this fixed, evenly-dividing step.
185	        self.slide_ms = slide_ms
186	        # Name of the dimension table this stream joins against, if any.
187	        self.lookup_table = lookup_table
188	        self.watermark: int | None = None
189	        # Maximum timestamp_ms of a successfully accepted event; only
190	        # maintained on automatic streams, None until the first such event.
191	        self.max_event_timestamp: int | None = None
192	        # window_start_ms -> [count, sum]; only non-empty windows exist.
193	        self._windows: dict[int, list] = {}
194	        self._finalized: list[dict] = []
195	        self._finalized_starts: set[int] = set()
196	        # event_id -> (timestamp_ms, value) for accepted, not yet evicted
197	        # ids; joined streams append the lookup_key to the tuple.
198	        self._dedup: dict[str, tuple] = {}
199	        # Joined streams only: window_start_ms -> (lookup_key, label) ->
200	        # [count, sum] for open windows, plus the finalized group rows in
201	        # results order (window start, lookup_key, label).
202	        self._joined_windows: dict[int, dict[tuple[str, str], list]] = {}
203	        self._joined_finalized: list[dict] = []
204	
205	    @property
206	    def _step_ms(self) -> int:
207	        """Grid spacing: slide_ms for sliding streams, else window_ms."""
208	        return self.slide_ms if self.slide_ms is not None else self.window_ms
209	
210	    def _window_starts(self, timestamp_ms: int) -> list[int]:
211	        """Starts of every grid window covering ``timestamp_ms``.
212	
213	        Windows are ``[start, start + window_ms)`` with ``start`` on the
214	        grid of multiples of the step; the floor division keeps the same
215	        boundaries for negative timestamps. The list is ascending, which
216	        is also the finalization/results order.
217	        """
218	        step = self._step_ms
219	        last = (timestamp_ms // step) * step
220	        first = last - (self.window_ms - step)
221	        return list(range(first, last + 1, step))
222	
223	    def add_event(
224	        self,
225	        timestamp_ms: int,
226	        value: float,
227	        event_id: str | None = None,
228	        lookup_key: str | None = None,
229	        label_of=None,
230	    ) -> dict:
231	        """Process one event against the pre-event watermark.
232	
233	        On automatic streams every response additionally carries the
234	        post-processing ``watermark_ms`` (``None`` until a watermark exists)
235	        and the ``finalized`` windows produced by this response; duplicate
236	        and dropped events leave the watermark untouched and finalize
237	        nothing. Accepted-event bookkeeping (maximum event timestamp plus
238	        the resulting monotone watermark advance) only runs after
239	        aggregation and dedup registration.
240	
241	        On joined streams the current label for ``lookup_key`` is read
242	        through ``label_of`` after the dedup and lateness decisions but
243	        before any state mutation, so an unknown key raises
244	        LookupKeyNotFoundError with all state untouched. The dedup check
245	        includes the lookup key: an exact retry repeats timestamp, value
246	        and key, while the same id with a different key conflicts.
247	        """
248	        automatic = self.auto_watermark_lag_ms is not None
249	        joined = self.lookup_table is not None
250	        if self.dedup_retention_ms is not None:
251	            retained = self._dedup.get(event_id)
252	            if retained is not None:
253	                same = retained[0] == timestamp_ms and retained[1] == value
254	                if joined:
255	                    same = same and retained[2] == lookup_key
256	                if same:
257	                    outcome: dict = {"dropped": False, "duplicate": True}
258	                    if automatic:
259	                        outcome.update(watermark_ms=self.watermark, finalized=[])
260	                    return outcome
261	                raise EventIdConflictError(event_id)
262	            if self._is_too_late(timestamp_ms):
263	                # Unseen too-late ids are dropped without being remembered.
264	                outcome = {"dropped": True, "duplicate": False}
265	                if automatic:
266	                    outcome.update(watermark_ms=self.watermark, finalized=[])
267	                return outcome
268	            label = self._resolve_label(label_of, lookup_key)
269	            self._aggregate(timestamp_ms, value, lookup_key, label)
270	            self._dedup[event_id] = (
271	                (timestamp_ms, value, lookup_key)
272	                if joined
273	                else (timestamp_ms, value)
274	            )
275	            outcome = {"dropped": False, "duplicate": False}
276	        else:
277	            if self._is_too_late(timestamp_ms):
278	                outcome = {"dropped": True}
279	                if automatic:
280	                    outcome.update(watermark_ms=self.watermark, finalized=[])
281	                return outcome
282	            label = self._resolve_label(label_of, lookup_key)
283	            self._aggregate(timestamp_ms, value, lookup_key, label)
284	            outcome = {"dropped": False}
285	        if automatic:
286	            newly = self._note_accepted_event(timestamp_ms)
287	            outcome.update(watermark_ms=self.watermark, finalized=newly)
288	        return outcome
289	
290	    def _resolve_label(self, label_of, lookup_key: str | None):
291	        """Read the current label for a joined event, or None on plain streams."""
292	        if self.lookup_table is None:
293	            return None
294	        return label_of(lookup_key)
295	
296	    def _is_too_late(self, timestamp_ms: int) -> bool:
297	        return (
298	            self.watermark is not None
299	            and timestamp_ms < self.watermark - self.allowed_lateness_ms
300	        )
301	
302	    def _note_accepted_event(self, timestamp_ms: int) -> list[dict]:
303	        """Advance the max event timestamp and then the watermark."""
304	        if (
305	            self.max_event_timestamp is None
306	            or timestamp_ms > self.max_event_timestamp
307	        ):
308	            self.max_event_timestamp = timestamp_ms
309	        target = self.max_event_timestamp - self.auto_watermark_lag_ms
310	        if self.watermark is None or target > self.watermark:
311	            # Publish through the shared path so finalization and dedup
312	            # eviction behave exactly like a manual advance.
313	            return self.advance_watermark(target)
314	        return []
315	
316	    def _aggregate(
317	        self,
318	        timestamp_ms: int,
319	        value: float,
320	        lookup_key: str | None = None,
321	        label: str | None = None,
322	    ) -> None:
323	        for start in self._window_starts(timestamp_ms):
324	            bucket = self._windows.setdefault(start, [0, 0])
325	            bucket[0] += 1
326	            bucket[1] += value
327	            if self.lookup_table is not None:
328	                groups = self._joined_windows.setdefault(start, {})
329	                group = groups.setdefault((lookup_key, label), [0, 0])
330	                group[0] += 1
331	                group[1] += value
332	
333	    def advance_watermark(self, watermark_ms: int) -> list[dict]:
334	        if self.watermark is not None and watermark_ms < self.watermark:
335	            raise WatermarkRegressionError(
336	                f"watermark {watermark_ms} is below current {self.watermark}"
337	            )
338	        self.watermark = watermark_ms
339	        newly: list[dict] = []
340	        for start in sorted(self._windows):
341	            if start in self._finalized_starts:
342	                continue
343	            end = start + self.window_ms
344	            if watermark_ms >= end + self.allowed_lateness_ms:
345	                count, total = self._windows[start]
346	                newly.append(
347	                    {
348	                        "stream": self.name,
349	                        "window_start_ms": start,
350	                        "window_end_ms": end,
351	                        "count": count,
352	                        "sum": total,
353	                    }
354	                )
355	                self._finalized_starts.add(start)
356	                if self.lookup_table is not None:
357	                    # Joined groups finalize synchronously with their window,
358	                    # ordered by (lookup_key, label) within it.
359	                    groups = self._joined_windows.pop(start, {})
360	                    for key, group_label in sorted(groups):
361	                        group_count, group_sum = groups[(key, group_label)]
362	                        self._joined_finalized.append(
363	                            {
364	                                "stream": self.name,
365	                                "window_start_ms": start,
366	                                "window_end_ms": end,
367	                                "lookup_key": key,
368	                                "label": group_label,
369	                                "count": group_count,
370	                                "sum": group_sum,
371	                            }
372	                        )
373	        self._finalized.extend(newly)
374	        if self.dedup_retention_ms is not None:
375	            horizon = watermark_ms - self.dedup_retention_ms
376	            self._dedup = {
377	                event_id: kept
378	                for event_id, kept in self._dedup.items()
379	                if kept[0] >= horizon
380	            }
381	        return newly
382	
383	    def results(self) -> list[dict]:
384	        return [dict(row) for row in self._finalized]
385	
386	    def to_snapshot(self) -> dict:
387	        """Serialize this stream as one entry of a version-1 snapshot."""
388	        entry: dict = {
389	            "name": self.name,
390	            "window_ms": self.window_ms,
391	            "allowed_lateness_ms": self.allowed_lateness_ms,
392	            "dedup_retention_ms": self.dedup_retention_ms,
393	            "watermark_ms": self.watermark,
394	            "windows": [
395	                {
396	                    "window_start_ms": start,
397	                    "window_end_ms": start + self.window_ms,
398	                    "count": self._windows[start][0],
399	                    "sum": self._windows[start][1],
400	                }
401	                for start in sorted(self._windows)
402	                if start not in self._finalized_starts
403	            ],
404	            "finalized": sorted(
405	                (dict(row) for row in self._finalized),
406	                key=lambda row: row["window_start_ms"],
407	            ),
408	        }
409	        if self.auto_watermark_lag_ms is not None:
410	            # Automatic streams publish the pair together; manual streams
411	            # keep the historical document shape exactly.
412	            entry["auto_watermark_lag_ms"] = self.auto_watermark_lag_ms
413	            entry["max_event_timestamp_ms"] = self.max_event_timestamp
414	        if self.slide_ms is not None:
415	            # Sliding streams publish the step; documents without it
416	            # restore as tumbling streams.
417	            entry["slide_ms"] = self.slide_ms
418	        if self.lookup_table is not None:
419	            # Joined streams publish the table reference plus the grouped
420	            # state; only format_version 2 documents may carry these.
421	            entry["lookup_table"] = self.lookup_table
422	            joined_open = []
423	            for start in sorted(self._joined_windows):
424	                groups = self._joined_windows[start]
425	                for key, group_label in sorted(groups):
426	                    group_count, group_sum = groups[(key, group_label)]
427	                    joined_open.append(
428	                        {
429	                            "window_start_ms": start,
430	                            "window_end_ms": start + self.window_ms,
431	                            "lookup_key": key,
432	                            "label": group_label,
433	                            "count": group_count,
434	                            "sum": group_sum,
435	                        }
436	                    )
437	            entry["joined_windows"] = joined_open
438	            entry["joined_finalized"] = [dict(row) for row in self._joined_finalized]
439	        if self.dedup_retention_ms is not None:
440	            records = []
441	            for event_id, kept in sorted(self._dedup.items()):
442	                record = {
443	                    "event_id": event_id,
444	                    "timestamp_ms": kept[0],
445	                    "value": kept[1],
446	                }
447	                if self.lookup_table is not None:
448	                    record["lookup_key"] = kept[2]
449	                records.append(record)
450	            entry["dedup_records"] = records
451	        return entry
452	
453	    @classmethod
454	    def from_snapshot(
455	        cls, data: object, table_names: set[str] | None = None
456	    ) -> "_Stream":
457	        """Rebuild one stream from a snapshot entry or raise SnapshotError.
458	
459	        Every structural and semantic rule is checked and nothing is
460	        repaired: callers get a fully formed stream or nothing. Join
461	        fields (``lookup_table``, ``joined_windows``, ``joined_finalized``)
462	        are only accepted when ``table_names`` is given (a version 2
463	        document); the referenced table must be one of them.
464	        """
465	        if not isinstance(data, dict):
466	            raise SnapshotError("stream entry must be an object")
467	        allowed = {
468	            "name",
469	            "window_ms",
470	            "allowed_lateness_ms",
471	            "dedup_retention_ms",
472	            "watermark_ms",
473	            "windows",
474	            "finalized",
475	            "dedup_records",
476	            "auto_watermark_lag_ms",
477	            "max_event_timestamp_ms",
478	            "slide_ms",
479	        }
480	        if table_names is not None:
481	            allowed |= {"lookup_table", "joined_windows", "joined_finalized"}
482	        extra = sorted(set(data) - allowed)
483	        if extra:
484	            raise SnapshotError(f"stream entry has unexpected field: {extra[0]}")
485	        required = {
486	            "name",
487	            "window_ms",
488	            "allowed_lateness_ms",
489	            "dedup_retention_ms",
490	            "watermark_ms",
491	            "windows",
492	            "finalized",
493	        }
494	        missing = sorted(required - set(data))
495	        if missing:
496	            raise SnapshotError(f"stream entry missing required field: {missing[0]}")
497	
498	        # The automatic-watermark pair must appear together; a document
499	        # without it restores as a manual stream.
500	        has_lag = "auto_watermark_lag_ms" in data
501	        has_max = "max_event_timestamp_ms" in data
502	        if has_lag != has_max:
503	            raise SnapshotError(
504	                f"stream entry automatic-watermark fields must appear together: "
505	                f"auto_watermark_lag_ms and max_event_timestamp_ms"
506	            )
507	        auto_lag = data.get("auto_watermark_lag_ms") if has_lag else None
508	        if has_lag and (not _is_int(auto_lag) or auto_lag < 0):
509	            raise SnapshotError(
510	                f"stream {data.get('name')!r}: auto_watermark_lag_ms must be a "
511	                f"non-negative integer"
512	            )
513	        max_event_timestamp = data.get("max_event_timestamp_ms") if has_max else None
514	        if has_max and max_event_timestamp is not None and not _is_int(
515	            max_event_timestamp
516	        ):
517	            raise SnapshotError(
518	                f"stream {data.get('name')!r}: max_event_timestamp_ms must be an "
519	                f"integer or null"
520	            )
521	
522	        name = data.get("name")
523	        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name:
524	            raise SnapshotError("stream name must be a non-empty string")
525	        window_ms = data.get("window_ms")
526	        if not _is_int(window_ms) or window_ms <= 0:
527	            raise SnapshotError(f"stream {name!r}: window_ms must be a positive integer")
528	        slide_ms = data.get("slide_ms") if "slide_ms" in data else None
529	        if "slide_ms" in data and (
530	            not _is_int(slide_ms)
531	            or slide_ms <= 0
532	            or slide_ms > window_ms
533	            or window_ms % slide_ms != 0
534	        ):
535	            raise SnapshotError(
536	                f"stream {name!r}: slide_ms must be a positive integer no larger "
537	                f"than window_ms that evenly divides it"
538	            )
539	        allowed_lateness_ms = data.get("allowed_lateness_ms")
540	        if not _is_int(allowed_lateness_ms) or allowed_lateness_ms < 0:
541	            raise SnapshotError(
542	                f"stream {name!r}: allowed_lateness_ms must be a non-negative integer"
543	            )
544	        retention = data.get("dedup_retention_ms")
545	        if retention is not None and (not _is_int(retention) or retention <= 0):
546	            raise SnapshotError(
547	                f"stream {name!r}: dedup_retention_ms must be a positive integer"
548	            )
549	        if retention is not None and retention < allowed_lateness_ms:
550	            raise SnapshotError(
551	                f"stream {name!r}: dedup_retention_ms must be at least allowed_lateness_ms"
552	            )
553	        watermark = data.get("watermark_ms")
554	        if watermark is not None and not _is_int(watermark):
555	            raise SnapshotError(f"stream {name!r}: watermark_ms must be an integer or null")
556	        if max_event_timestamp is not None and watermark is None:
557	            raise SnapshotError(
558	                f"stream {name!r}: non-null max_event_timestamp_ms requires a "
559	                f"non-null watermark"
560	            )
561	
562	        lookup_table = data.get("lookup_table")
563	        if "lookup_table" in data:
564	            if not isinstance(lookup_table, str) or not lookup_table:
565	                raise SnapshotError(
566	                    f"stream {name!r}: lookup_table must be a non-empty string"
567	                )
568	            if lookup_table not in table_names:
569	                raise SnapshotError(
570	                    f"stream {name!r}: unknown lookup_table {lookup_table!r}"
571	                )
572	            for field in ("joined_windows", "joined_finalized"):
573	                if field not in data:
574	                    raise SnapshotError(
575	                        f"stream entry missing required field: {field}"
576	                    )
577	        else:
578	            for field in ("joined_windows", "joined_finalized"):
579	                if field in data:
580	                    raise SnapshotError(
581	                        f"stream {name!r}: {field} present without lookup_table"
582	                    )
583	
584	        stream = cls(
585	            name,
586	            window_ms,
587	            allowed_lateness_ms,
588	            retention,
589	            auto_lag,
590	            slide_ms,
591	            lookup_table,
592	        )
593	        stream.watermark = watermark
594	        stream.max_event_timestamp = max_event_timestamp
595	
596	        finalized_rows = cls._parse_window_list(
597	            data.get("finalized"),
598	            name,
599	            window_ms,
600	            "finalized",
601	            with_stream=True,
602	            step_ms=stream._step_ms,
603	        )
604	        if finalized_rows and watermark is None:
605	            raise SnapshotError(
606	                f"stream {name!r}: finalized windows require a non-null watermark"
607	            )
608	        for row in finalized_rows:
609	            start = row["window_start_ms"]
610	            if watermark is not None and watermark < start + window_ms + allowed_lateness_ms:
611	                raise SnapshotError(
612	                    f"stream {name!r}: finalized window {start} requires a watermark "
613	                    f"of at least {start + window_ms + allowed_lateness_ms}"
614	                )
615	            if row["stream"] != name:
616	                raise SnapshotError(
617	                    f"stream {name!r}: finalized row labels stream {row['stream']!r}"
618	                )
619	            stream._finalized_starts.add(start)
620	            stream._finalized.append(dict(row))
621	
622	        open_rows = cls._parse_window_list(
623	            data.get("windows"),
624	            name,
625	            window_ms,
626	            "windows",
627	            with_stream=False,
628	            step_ms=stream._step_ms,
629	        )
630	        for row in open_rows:
631	            start = row["window_start_ms"]
632	            if start in stream._finalized_starts:
633	                raise SnapshotError(
634	                    f"stream {name!r}: window {start} is both open and finalized"
635	                )
636	            if watermark is not None and watermark >= start + window_ms + allowed_lateness_ms:
637	                raise SnapshotError(
638	                    f"stream {name!r}: open window {start} should already be finalized "
639	                    f"at watermark {watermark}"
640	                )
641	            stream._windows[start] = [row["count"], row["sum"]]
642	
643	        if lookup_table is not None:
644	            cls._load_joined_state(stream, data, name, window_ms)
645	
646	        if retention is not None:
647	            records = data.get("dedup_records")
648	            stream._load_dedup_records(records, joined=lookup_table is not None)
649	        elif "dedup_records" in data:
650	            raise SnapshotError(
651	                f"stream {name!r}: dedup_records present without dedup_retention_ms"
652	            )
653	
654	        if auto_lag is not None and max_event_timestamp is None:
655	            # No accepted event has ever happened, so no window can carry
656	            # aggregates either.
657	            if stream._windows or stream._finalized_starts:
658	                raise SnapshotError(
659	                    f"stream {name!r}: null max_event_timestamp_ms requires no "
660	                    f"open or finalized windows"
661	                )
662	        if auto_lag is not None and max_event_timestamp is not None:
663	            # The remembered maximum must be backed by an accepted event, so
664	            # every window it aggregates into has to be open or finalized
665	            # (one window on tumbling streams, several overlapping ones on
666	            # sliding streams).
667	            known = stream._windows.keys() | stream._finalized_starts
668	            for covered in stream._window_starts(max_event_timestamp):
669	                if covered not in known:
670	                    raise SnapshotError(
671	                        f"stream {name!r}: max_event_timestamp_ms "
672	                        f"{max_event_timestamp} aggregates into unknown window "
673	                        f"{covered}"
674	                    )
675	            # A valid automatic state always has watermark >= max event
676	            # timestamp minus the configured lag.
677	            if watermark < max_event_timestamp - auto_lag:
678	                raise SnapshotError(
679	                    f"stream {name!r}: watermark {watermark} is below "
680	                    f"max_event_timestamp_ms - auto_watermark_lag_ms "
681	                    f"({max_event_timestamp - auto_lag})"
682	                )
683	        return stream

685	    @staticmethod
686	    def _parse_window_list(
687	        value: object,
688	        name: str,
689	        window_ms: int,
690	        where: str,
691	        *,
692	        with_stream: bool,
693	        step_ms: int | None = None,
694	    ) -> list[dict]:
695	        if not isinstance(value, list):
696	            raise SnapshotError(f"stream {name!r}: {where} must be an array")
697	        if step_ms is None:
698	            step_ms = window_ms
699	        fields = (
700	            {"stream", "window_start_ms", "window_end_ms", "count", "sum"}
701	            if with_stream
702	            else {"window_start_ms", "window_end_ms", "count", "sum"}
703	        )
704	        rows: list[dict] = []
705	        previous: int | None = None
706	        for raw in value:
707	            if not isinstance(raw, dict):
708	                raise SnapshotError(f"stream {name!r}: {where} entries must be objects")
709	            extra = sorted(set(raw) - fields)
710	            if extra:
711	                raise SnapshotError(
712	                    f"stream {name!r}: {where} entry has unexpected field: {extra[0]}"
713	                )
714	            missing = sorted(fields - set(raw))
715	            if missing:
716	                raise SnapshotError(
